### Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`composer test`)
- [ ] Code style is clean (`composer lint`)
- [ ] Static analysis is clean (`composer analyse`)
- [ ] `dist/` was rebuilt if `resources/js` changed (`npm run prod`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
